lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density of larger centroids located mid-laterally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the blob clusters, forming a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as nodes, particularly visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank showing a transition from high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs located within the visible portion of the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily situated on the mid-to-lower section of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of several remoras positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
